title: Each column must be covered once
hook: Covering one column may invalidate rows through other columns too.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Search trees; minimax and a partial solution state.
doesNotKnow: Solve exact cover by choosing a row and removing all rows conflicting on its columns.

misconception: Covering every column at least once satisfies exact cover.
objective: Solve exact cover by choosing a row and removing all rows conflicting on its columns.

claims.text: Choosing a row covers all its columns and removes every row sharing any of them. A valid completion covers every column exactly once. The second input removes one candidate row, so the search must find a different partition.
